variants.specifics: Brackenford: Wenna, the miller's widow, wants the Cloak of Mists back from the Urchins who raided the mill.

offer.speaker: Wenna
offer.text: Ooooh, how could this happen? Those nasty Urchins knocked down both of my millhands. There's no time to run for help. Quickly, will you go after them before my Cloak of Mists is lost in the old barrow east of the ford?

refusal.speaker: Wenna
refusal.text: Ooooh... Then the Cloak is as good as gone. Come back if you change your mind.

reminder.speaker: Wenna
reminder.text: Please, I'm begging you. Chase down those sneaky Urchins and bring back my Cloak of Mists.

completion.speaker: Wenna
completion.text: My Cloak of Mists is saved! You'll need good boots for the climb up Crow Hill. Here, take these with you.

after.speaker: Wenna
after.text: You may well have saved the whole mill with your courage. Well done, young sir! Now, hurry on to Crow Hill.

journal.text: Recover the Cloak of Mists stolen by the Urchins.

journal_done.text: COMPLETED: Recover the Cloak of Mists stolen by the Urchins.

variants.writer: Claude Code subagent, Claude Opus 5.5 (claude-opus-5-5), writer 1

variants.specifics: Ostrum: Old Ottla, nearly deaf, had her ear horn stolen by the Imps that nest in the old shafts.

offer.speaker: Ottla
offer.text:
Aaaieee! Mercy! Don't hurt me!

Eh? Just a stranger?! I didn't hear you come in. Well, you're not one of those wretched Imps who ran off with my ear horn! I'm nearly deaf without it.

If you'd fetch it back, you'd be saving my life. I'd never forget it! Will you do it?

refusal.speaker: Ottla
refusal.text: Fine then, go! I didn't hear a word you said anyway!

reminder.speaker: Ottla
reminder.text: Have you got my ear horn?! Eh.... Well, those Imps keep a nest down in the old shafts below the lift.

completion.speaker: Ottla
completion.text: My ear horn! You found it! Bless you, kind sir, bless you! And please, take this book. It holds every spell I learned when I was young. It would serve any adventurer well.

after.speaker: Ottla
after.text: Thank you again, kind sir! I can hear every word now!

journal.text: Recover Ottla's ear horn from the Imps.

journal_done.text: COMPLETED: Recover Ottla's ear horn from the Imps.

variants.specifics: Vell: Oswig the Sage lost the Staff of Binding to Grulga's Trolls, who took it to the Troll caves.

offer.speaker: Oswig
offer.text: Greetings, Wanderer! Thank goodness you've come at last, for we sorely need your help. Grulga's Trolls swept through Vell only days ago and carried off the Staff of Binding! Will you go to the Troll caves to the southwest and bring the precious Staff back to me as quickly as you can?

refusal.speaker: Oswig
refusal.text: No?! Then I fear Vell is doomed! Please reconsider.

reminder.speaker: Oswig
reminder.text: Make haste and recover the Staff! Go quickly, please! For if she keeps it, Grulga will turn the Staff to the foulest of ends, for certain!

completion.speaker: Oswig
completion.text:
Well done, brave Wanderer! My deepest thanks for bringing back the Staff! Now that we have it again, we can at last put an end to that wicked witch's schemes for good!

Here, these blue potions and this spell book should prove useful... more useful than you know.

after.speaker: Oswig
after.text: My thanks once more, Wanderer, for everything you've done.

journal_done.text: COMPLETED: Retrieve the Staff of Binding.

variants.specifics: Tarnhold: Ottla, the brewer's wife; an Imp in the brewery cellar stole her husband's magic cloak. She hands over the cellar key.

offer.speaker: Ottla
offer.text:
At last! My husband brews the finest ale in Tarnhold. Unfortunately, a nasty little Imp has moved into the cellar below our brewery. He stole my husband's magic cloak and now he bites anyone who goes down the stairs.

Will you kill the Imp and bring back the cloak? When you return, I'll make it worth your while.

Here, take this iron key, it opens the cellar door.

refusal.speaker: Ottla
refusal.text:
Pity, I doubt anyone else in town will have work for you.

Should you think better of it, I'll be at the brewery behind the barracks.

reminder.speaker: Ottla
reminder.text: Take heart, one puny Imp can't do much harm. Return once he's dead and you have the cloak.

completion.speaker: Ottla
completion.text:
Wonderful! You've killed the Imp and found the cloak!

Here is your reward. Take it to Brokk at the forge and he'll fix you up for the Ogres. Good luck!

after.speaker: Ottla
after.text: Thanks again for the cloak, kind stranger!

journal.text: Kill the Imp in the brewery cellar and bring back the magic cloak.

journal_done.text: COMPLETED: Kill the Imp in the brewery cellar and bring back the magic cloak.

variants.specifics: Tolvin: Ysolde the healer sends the player through the old tunnel under her house to fetch the Staff of Mending from her brother Corm's hut, where the Urchins have been.

offer.speaker: Ysolde
offer.text:
While I tend to the fishermen hurt in these raids, there's another errand I need run.

Corm, my brother, has sent word that he has finished the Staff of Mending I asked him to make. But nobody has heard a peep from him since the Urchins started prowling the east shore.

Under this house there is an old tunnel which we used to hide from raiders. It comes out at Corm's hut. Just stand beside the barrels at the back of this room and you'll find the way in.

Will you fetch the Staff for me and see how Corm is faring?

refusal.speaker: Ysolde
refusal.text: Then I'll find someone braver to go.

reminder.speaker: Ysolde
reminder.text: Down the tunnel beside the barrels! Hurry!

completion.speaker: Ysolde
completion.text:
You have the Staff of Mending! Wonderful!

But my fears for poor Corm have come true, I see. I will miss him, but there's no time for grieving now. Mayor Gorvane needs every able hand and he has asked to see you.

Take this Ankh for your trouble. Good luck, lad!

after.speaker: Ysolde
after.text: Thank you again, lad. Go and see Mayor Gorvane.

journal.text: Retrieve the Staff of Mending which Corm has made.

journal_done.text: COMPLETED: Retrieve the Staff of Mending which Corm has made.

variants.specifics: Olvane: Master Ostrigan's magic spectacles were carried off by Imps loose from the summoning hall to their nest in the old Bell Tower.

offer.speaker: Ostrigan
offer.text:
Sneaky little devils! Those Imps got loose from the summoning hall and they're already making a dreadful nuisance of themselves!

I am Master Ostrigan. My magic spectacles have gone missing. I fear the Imps carried them off to their nest in the old Bell Tower.

If you bring them back to me, I will gladly take you on as a student of the College. The Bell Tower is just across the square. Will you help a half-blind old man?

refusal.speaker: Ostrigan
refusal.text: Oh dear... Then I suppose I shall sit here and squint.

reminder.speaker: Ostrigan
reminder.text: Have you got my spectacles yet? Oh my, I can't read a single page without them.

completion.speaker: Ostrigan
completion.text:
My spectacles! Those wretched Imps must have chewed on them.

You have shown the Imps were no match for you. Maybe you would make a fine student here after all. Hmmm... Quite so.

Take this spell book. When you have the time, come up to my study and we shall begin your lessons. There is a great deal to cover.

after.speaker: Ostrigan
after.text: Whenever you're ready, just come up to my study and we'll begin.

journal.text: Recover Master Ostrigan's magic spectacles from the Imps.

journal_done.text: Visit Master Ostrigan's study to begin your lessons.

variants.specifics: Fort Ostkar: Osk the healer lost his healing staff to the Imps that overran the cellars under his infirmary.

offer.speaker: Osk
offer.text:
Where were you all this time!? We have a dreadful problem!

Overgrown bats and screeching Imps from deep inside the mountain have overrun the cellars under my infirmary. Good men have bled in defense of the fort's precious stores!

And one of those Imps flew off with my healing staff! Please, I beg of you! Get my staff back from the beasts and you'll be handsomely rewarded.

This key opens the cellar door behind the infirmary. The Imps' nest lies somewhere beyond.

I also have a potion which might prove quite handy. Will you help me?

refusal.speaker: Osk
refusal.text: Very well. I suppose the wounded must suffer without it, then.

reminder.speaker: Osk
reminder.text: Come back to me once you have my staff and I'll pay you as promised.

completion.speaker: Osk
completion.text:
You are a true hero! A thousand thanks.

While you were down in the cellars, fighting the Imps, Brannoc came by, asking after you. He wants to see you in the Keep -- at the top of the hill.

Before you leave, please take this gold for your efforts.

after.speaker: Osk
after.text: Brannoc is a fine Warden. You'd do well to heed his counsel.

journal.text: Clear the Imps from the infirmary cellars and recover Osk's staff.

journal_done.text: COMPLETED: Clear the Imps from the infirmary cellars and recover Osk's staff.

variants.specifics: Orvak: Elsbeth's husband Bram's fireproof gauntlets were stolen by Urchins, who ran off toward the Slag Heaps.

offer.speaker: Elsbeth
offer.text:
Urchins just ran off with my husband's fireproof gauntlets! If I don't get them back, he'll be ruined. He's due home any minute!

Please, help me, kind sir! I think the Urchins who grabbed them ran off toward the Slag Heaps.

Would you... could you bring them back for me?

refusal.speaker: Elsbeth
refusal.text: Oh... Fine, then. I'll just have to tell Bram myself.

reminder.speaker: Elsbeth
reminder.text: Hurry, please, kind sir! Bram could walk in at any moment!

completion.speaker: Elsbeth
completion.text: Oh, bless you! Thank you, thank you! Please accept this as a token of my appreciation!

journal.text: Recover Bram's fireproof gauntlets from the Urchins at the Slag Heaps.

journal_done.text: COMPLETED: Recover Bram's fireproof gauntlets from the Urchins at the Slag Heaps.

variants.specifics: Torvel Cross: Old Hulda's house was smashed up by the Ogres and one of them is asleep on her magic cloak in the back room.

offer.speaker: Hulda
offer.text:
Please, help me, kind stranger! The Ogres have smashed up my house and one of the brutes is asleep on my magic cloak in the back room!

Bring it back to me and I'll be in your debt forever! Will you do it?

refusal.speaker: Hulda
refusal.text: Oh, no! Then who will save my cloak?!

reminder.speaker: Hulda
reminder.text: Keep anything else you find in there! Just hurry and bring my cloak!

completion.speaker: Hulda
completion.text:
Thank goodness, you found it! How will I ever pay back such courage?!

What's that? A big sack of gold? Well, if that's what you want, please accept this as a token of my appreciation.

journal.text: Retrieve Hulda's magic cloak from the Ogre in her house.

journal_done.text: COMPLETED: Retrieve Hulda's magic cloak from the Ogre in her house.

variants.specifics: Corvale: Mayor Pudrick's amulet was stolen from the Town Hall by the Imps, who fled into the Old Quarry north of town.

offer.speaker: Mayor Pudrick
offer.text:
Welcome to Corvale, brave Adventurer! We've been waiting for you!

The Imps who live up in the hills have gone wild! They crept into the Town Hall and stole my amulet! A farmhand chased the little devils into the Old Quarry, but never came back.

Will you go north to the quarry and win back my amulet from the Imps? When you return, please come see me. I'll be in the Town Hall.

refusal.speaker: Mayor Pudrick
refusal.text: Oh.... Well, I suppose the Imps can keep it, then.

reminder.speaker: Mayor Pudrick
reminder.text: Those wretched Imps get bolder every day.

completion.speaker: Mayor Pudrick
completion.text:
My amulet! Thank you, kind sir! The whole of Corvale is grateful for your valiant deed.

Here, take this as a small gift from the town. Master Ebbrin is waiting for you at his house on the hill. Stock up at the shops first, then go and see him right away.

after.speaker: Mayor Pudrick
after.text: I have only my thanks left to give. You should go see Master Ebbrin. He has been asking for you.

journal.text: Recover Mayor Pudrick's amulet from the Imps.

journal_done.text: COMPLETED: Recover Mayor Pudrick's amulet from the Imps.
